objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to a document; not language-independent and the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document and adaptable to different requirements.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of a document that can be printed in the document through TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status of a document that can be printed in the document through TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope of a document that can be printed in the document through TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity starts; updated for each newly released version.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a check of extended validity is necessary; definable for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained; definable for each document type.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document; can have document templates and configurable validity/archive periods.

objs.name: document_level
objs.description: Level used to differentiate documents for clarity and evaluation options.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New object attached in the system to create documents, additional information, attachments, or requests.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: Document generated based on standard MS Office formats.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format automatically created after saving a document and displayed on the web.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific data maintained for a document in categories.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example and attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Object with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data with which documents can be automatically linked through database integration.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the release of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of an attachment, as attachments are subject to their own versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status passed through in the release process of the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Additional object added to a document and released or published directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Document attachment or relevant equipment/additional object described as addable to each document and reactivated with the document.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change rights assigned at user group and person level for a document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system user who can have roles, permissions, workflow tasks, notifications, acknowledgements, and dashboard entries.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Person assigned in authorizations, distribution, or document attributes.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for role assignment, reader authorization, distribution, or archive access.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Role or user group whose members can view approved objects and dependent objects.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person assigned to a document who signs creation in the first workflow step and receives read and write permissions.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person assigned additional personal change rights on a document and allowed to start the release process.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person assigned to check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for a document and its content and assigned to release, validity extension, or override processes.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Role that can translate released content into another language and cannot independently create new objects.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents when other rights are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document created and managed without affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before the validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to revalidate invalidated documents and select the corresponding document for reactivation.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Workflow-supported processing mechanism used for approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and completed in the system.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, status, change proposals, validity extension, override, distribution, and acknowledgements.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Assignment of User Groups and persons to a document for read authorization, e-mail distribution, acknowledgement, and dashboard filling.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display filled based on distribution groups and document relevance.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report for documents, instructions, monitoring, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible in the corresponding login language after release.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: cockpit
objs.description: Place where change proposals and distribution list are maintained or displayed for a document.

objs.name: folder
objs.description: Named storage location such as Change proposals folder or folder for reactivation requests.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Creation of a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Selection of one of the document templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Creation of a pure object cover for external files or generated documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload of external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generation of new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintenance of standardized and customer-specific metadata via document properties.

evts.name: maintain_attribute
evts.description: Maintenance of attributes such as references, IT applications, relevant companies, or areas of validity via document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Editing of document content with the implemented editing client in a local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Saving of a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system-supported conversion of the saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display of the current converted document version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Changing a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: link_document
evts.description: Automatic or property-based linking of documents with processes, organizational units, risks, other documents, and Master data.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assignment of reader authorizations via User Group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assignment or confirmation of the author in the Author field.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assignment of additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assignment of reviewers maintained in attributes for review workflow steps.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assignment of releasers maintained in attributes for release workflow steps.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Adding an object of the type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Adding an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_information
evts.description: Release and publication of additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Direct deletion of additional information due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modification of an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking or archiving of attachments with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiation of the 3-step approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: complete_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: Reviewers complete technical or formal check tasks positively or reject during review.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: Releasers complete release task positively or reject during release.

evts.name: cancel_workflow
evts.description: Cancellation of workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after first rejection during review or release with multiple users.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users by e-mail notification.

evts.name: sign_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Documentation of signatures in the system for each released version and printing as document content.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final release of a document after workflow completion.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revision of a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a change proposal for a document by an employee with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Scheduling a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completion of a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of a request for validity extension.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declaration of additional validity, deletion of the request, and update of Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatic termination of validity extension process when a revised document version is released.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Creation of a request for override for a selected document by users with write access.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatic start of workflow for processing the request for override.

evts.name: process_override
evts.description: Workflow-supported checking and approval of override by releaser or by initiator, reviewer, and releaser.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declaration that a document is out of force, setting status on last valid approved version, deleting edited versions, and revoking rights except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physical deletion of archived documents after archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Creation of a request for reactivation in the folder provided and selection of corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatic start of workflow for reactivation request.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Initiator confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Revalidation of invalidated document by creating a new version and retaining metadata and properties from the time of AKS.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivation of Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution
evts.description: Maintenance of distribution list in the cockpit for the document.

evts.name: grant_distribution_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatic granting of read authorization to User Groups and persons assigned to Distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Informing assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic e-mail request to persons and users of assigned User Groups to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement in workflow-supported process without a signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notification to author team as soon as all persons in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement of the current version.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Filling user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned to a document.

evts.name: list_document
evts.description: Listing of all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_detail
evts.description: Display of details such as existing attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions in the dashboard footer.

evts.name: run_report
evts.description: Execution of role-specific evaluation reports and searches using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported check of the translated version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported release of the translated version, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specification of clients in which a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Creation of a new document in a client to describe a local addition to an original document.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Creation of a reference from a local document to the original document.
